entries.name: chair
entries.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Input image is the STRICT GEOMETRIC BLUEPRINT and EDIT TARGET. Paint a finished nostalgic 2000s Korean miniroom game sprite onto this blueprint. ivory chair with pink seat cushion and a pink back cushion featuring a heart embroidery, small gold trim and rose decal. Straight equal-thickness legs exactly following guide. Preserve the blueprint's camera, every vertex location, all edge directions, silhouette, lengths, equal leg thickness and verticals EXACTLY. This is a constrained paint-over, NOT a reinterpretation or a new camera angle. All grid-axis edges slope exactly 1:2; use the supplied drawing rather than guessing isometric. Make it charming ornate pastel pink/ivory/gold with fine pixel-art-inspired outlines, subtle texture and soft shading. Replace gray with material colors and black construction outlines with fine brown outlines. Remove white background to real transparency, retaining holes between legs as transparent. No added ground, shadow, text, objects or cropping. Keep the entire original object comfortably inside same canvas.
